title: Primary Sizing Station: Two-Sided Truck Dump, Rock Breaker, Apron Feeder, Twin-Shaft Sizer & Discharge Conveyor

flow.title: Ore path: truck → hopper → feeder → sizer → belt
flow.description: Run-of-mine bauxite is tipped, fed, sized to –200 mm and conveyed to the overland conveyor.

summary: The primary sizing station turns run-of-mine bauxite into a conveyable product. Haul trucks tip from two sides into a lined dump hopper; a pedestal rock breaker deals with oversize; an apron feeder draws ore out at a controlled rate into a twin-shaft mineral sizer that reduces lumps up to ~1.2–1.5 m to minus ~200 mm; the product drops onto a sacrificial conveyor that passes under a self-cleaning tramp magnet and a metal detector before the overland conveyor.

parts.name: Dump Pocket: tipping pads (sized for a 90 t truck to turn and reverse) on MSE walls with 1.55 m edge bunds, ramps (shown cut short), 1.55 m wheel stops, traffic lights, conveyor trench
Dump Hopper (~200–300 t live): AR-plate liners, rock-box ledges, skirts, impact rails, dust-spray headers
Pedestal Rock Breaker over the feeder outlet (boom, stick, ~2 t hammer, power pack, operator cabin) — tipping stops while it works
Apron Feeder (3.0 m manganese-steel pans, ~0.03–0.25 m/s VFD): frame, carry rollers, head drive, tail take-up, dribble conveyor
Apron-Feeder Pans and Chains (carry run moves toward the sizer)
Twin-Shaft Sizer Housing: side liners, breaker combs, central breaker bar, top covers, bearings, discharge chute
Sizer Shaft A (tooth rings, ~3 teeth per ring, scroll pattern)
Sizer Shaft B (counter-rotating, rings offset half a pitch)
Sizer Drive Trains (each shaft: gear coupling, right-angle gearbox, fluid coupling, ~400 kW motor)
Sizer Discharge (sacrificial) Conveyor: 1,400 mm belt in a trench under the sizer, impact beds, then 12° incline with walkway
Self-Cleaning Overband Magnet, Metal Detector, Belt Scale & Rip Detector
E-house (MCC, VFDs, PLC), Transformer and Lighting Mast
Bauxite: ROM lumps (≤ 1.2–1.5 m) to sized product (–200 mm)

ps_civil.function: Lets trucks reverse up and tip safely from both sides.
ps_civil.construction: Mechanically stabilised earth (MSE) or RC walls retaining two tipping pads ~10 m high, each large enough for a 90 t truck to turn and reverse (≈ 30–35 m clear); ramps; concrete wheel-stop bunds ≥ ½ the wheel height of the largest machine using the dump (1.55 m: the 45/65R45 wheel loader also tips here); traffic lights tell drivers when to tip.
inspection: Inspect bunds and lighting each shift

ps_hopper.function: Buffers truck deliveries so the feeder and sizer run steadily.
ps_hopper.construction: Steel hopper inside the concrete pocket; bolted 400–500 HB AR-plate liners, rock-box ledges at the impact zone, skirts down to the feeder, dust-spray ring.
inspection: Keep a level to avoid direct impact on the pans

ps_breaker.function: Breaks oversize and dislodges bridged ore without people entering the hopper.
ps_breaker.construction: Pedestal-mounted boom and stick with a ~2 t hydraulic hammer, slew base, power pack and an operator cabin overlooking the hopper.

ps_feeder.function: Draws ore from the hopper at a controlled rate and protects the sizer from the dumping impact.
ps_feeder.construction: Heavy apron feeder: 3.0 m manganese-steel pans on two chain strands, skirts inside the pan flights (2.6 m clear), impact rails under the hopper, ~12 carry rollers, head shaft with two shaft-mounted planetary gearboxes and motors (~2 × 132–160 kW, VFD), tail take-ups and a dribble conveyor beneath.
ps_feeder.material: Cast manganese steel pans, alloy chains.
ps_feeder.operating_conditions: Pan speed ~0.03–0.25 m/s; capacity up to ~2,400 t/h.
inspection: Pan and chain inspection; clean the dribble belt

ps_sizer.function: Contains the shafts and guides material through them.
ps_sizer.construction: Heavy fabricated box with replaceable side liners, breaker combs, bearing housings and a discharge chute.

ps_shafts.function: Break the ore by tension and shear between counter-rotating teeth (low speed, high torque).
ps_shafts.construction: Two shafts with rings of three replaceable horn-type teeth in a scroll pattern; the rings of one shaft sit between those of the other; slow inward counter-rotation draws lumps into the nip; oversize is scrolled along; a central breaker bar beneath gives the third breaking stage.
inspection: Measure tooth height; rebuild by hardfacing

ps_drives.construction: Per shaft: TEFC motor (~300–450 kW), fluid coupling (soft start, overload slip), right-angle gearbox and gear coupling; reversing on jam.
failure_modes: Fluid-coupling fusible plug blow on jams

ps_conveyor.function: Carries sized ore from under the sizer to the overland transfer.
ps_conveyor.construction: 1,400 mm fabric belt on 35° troughed idlers with impact beds in the loading zone, walkway and handrail, head drive at the transfer.
ps_conveyor.operating_conditions: Belt speed ~2.5–3 m/s; capacity up to ~2,400 t/h.

ps_tramp.function: Remove and detect tramp steel (bucket teeth, drill steel) before it reaches the overland belt.
ps_tramp.construction: Suspended self-cleaning overband magnet discharging to a tramp chute; balanced-coil metal detector with non-metallic idler zone and marker spray, placed so the belt can stop before the metal reaches the head; belt scale and rip detector. Austenitic manganese steel (feeder pans, liners, hammer tools) is non-magnetic — only the metal detector catches it.
inspection: Test with test pieces each shift

ps_electrical.function: Power and control for the station.
ps_electrical.construction: E-house with MCC, VFDs and PLC; transformer; lighting mast; CCTV for the tipping decks.

ps_ore.construction: ROM lumps up to ~1.2–1.5 m; product –200 mm (P80 ~100–130 mm).
